process.label: How I work
process.hint: Hover or tap a step to explore it.
steps: Before writing code, I clarify the process, the data and the real need.
I turn the problem into a solution that is simple, usable and maintainable.
I combine interface, logic, data and automation when it adds value.
I test the flow, document decisions and leave room to iterate.

profile.title: I make technology more useful and manageable.
profile.intro: I hold a Higher Technician qualification in Multiplatform Application Development, with hands-on IT support, internal-solution development and documentation experience. I enjoy the point at which an application stops being just code and starts saving someone work.
principles: I first understand the process, the data and the person who will use the solution.
Backend, automation, data and a clear interface when the problem calls for it.
I design for review, maintenance and improvement after delivery.
